text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I... won, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Did I... win?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It doesn't feel real at all, but... Did I really do it?

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Nice Natureee!!
Congratulationsss!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Kh!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, awesome...
There are so many...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Folk
text_block_list.text:
Nei-chaaan!
Congratulatiooons!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This is it, this is what I wanted!
I wanted to see you win on this very stage!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Everyone from the shopping district...
was watching too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You were waiting for me.
And I was able to... answer your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh!
Trainerrr...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I didn't give up...!
I'm so glad I kept chasing after it...!
These weren't the tears of anxiety she had shown before. These large tears of pure joy sparkled beneath the sun alongside her sweat.
Just then—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: —Geez, why are you crying?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're at the top because you beat *me*, you know?
*Me*, of all people...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh...!
You're the winner, so stand tall and smile!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...... Yeah, yeah, that's right.
You were smiling the whole time, too......

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I'm okay.
I won't... cry anymore.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"That's right, I can't hear you if you're crying.
This—"

text_block_list.name: Roar of the Crowd
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah...
Natureee!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
“—That thunderous cheer!
When all of it should have been yours...!”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I know.
I can... hear you loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...!
Phew-w-w...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"‘Incredible potential’, huh...?
Tch!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you run ahead of me ever again.
—Next time, I'm definitely going to win!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If you hadn't been here,
I... wouldn't have been able to run this far.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for letting me chase after your back this whole time.
Though honestly, running behind you wasn't easy.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But...
the sneaky side of me found it comfortable too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
“From now on, though,
I'll take any wind head-on!”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: As the protagonist of my own story!
The post-race winner's interview. Countless camera flashes were focused right on Nice Nature.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"—This Arima Kinen was full of
formidable rivals.
What do you think was the key factor in your victory?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're right...
I think everyone was truly strong.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: “Well, I'm a 'strong' Umamusume too. So I guess this is just the result of giving it my all.”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I can say with complete certainty...
that it's because of all that hard work!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Nice Nature,
one final word for your fans!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Um, to everyone who has supported me all this time...
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Even when there were times I couldn't meet expectations, you still cheered for me simply because it was me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I somehow made it this far.
...Even though it took quite a lot of effort!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...May I make
one selfish request?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Umm... I was hoping you'd keep cheering me on
from now on, too...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I'm sure there'll be times
when you're out of shape or things just fall apart."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Because it's not like I'm crazy talented,
or an insanely hard worker either."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But... you know.
I think there's just one thing I need to say.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
—That I'm the one Umamusume
who'll never betray their trust!
